description:
The Cancer iChart Archive app is open on the Welcome screen. Your task:
1. Tap 'Search For Drug Interactions'.
2. On the Cancer Drugs list, find and select 'Crizotinib' (use the A-Z index to jump to 'C').
3. Tap 'Next' to proceed to Co-medications.
4. On the Co-medications list, find and select 'Ketoconazole' (use the A-Z index to jump to 'K').
5. Tap 'Next' to see the Results.
6. Verify the result shows a red banner with 'Do Not Coadminister'.
